hypothesis: Replacing scalar swing progression and generic acceptance breaks with causal locked HH/HL or LH/LL structure and same-timeframe close-confirmed BOS will remove false structure sequences and improve timing discrimination without using outcome-selected thresholds.

expected_directions.enter_now_relative_to_wait: not assumed; measured only after semantic gates pass
expected_directions.profitability: not guaranteed and cannot be used to revise this experiment definition

major_version_reason: The v2 playbook registry declares required-sequence changes to be major, and this experiment replaces DFP and LSR sequence eligibility.
allowed_changes: new v3 registry, validation, action-clock and base-model configs
typed swing, structure and BOS observation contracts
DFP and LSR structure sequence hard gates
v3 causal sample schema and visualization layers
causality, boundary, regression, reset, resume and manifest tests
forbidden_changes: all v2 configs, artifacts and completed output roots
value model family, regularization or action advantage threshold
entry, stop, target or deadline rules
FVG, order block, support/resistance, liquidity-pool or accumulation definitions

fixed_case_sample.year_balance: two cases from each of 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020 and 2021
fixed_case_sample.selection: smallest SHA-256 of primitive-protocol-hash plus event-id within each stratum

economic_release_gates: Inherit every absolute v2.3 rolling-OOF, year, direction, regime, cost-stress, weekly-bootstrap, position-management and MBO gate without relaxation.
failure_and_stop_rules: A protocol/code/data hash receives at most one rolling-OOF evaluation.
A failed economic result cannot trigger threshold or weight tuning on the same validation windows.
A code bug found before viewing PnL may be fixed only by freezing a new hash and rerunning all semantic gates.
A code bug found after viewing PnL makes that window revealed and unavailable as independent confirmation.
Insufficient event coverage is unavailable, not a pass.
Any failed gate remains fail-closed and forbids sealed-data access.
Sealed holdout is revealed once only after every prior gate passes.
